nodes.label: Client HTML Shell (#root mount point)
nodes.rationale: A single empty #root div plus an ES-module script tag pointing at /src/main.jsx — the Vite SPA entry convention, with all rendering deferred to React.

nodes.label: Document Metadata (title and description)
